mapper.select: SELECT page FROM eh_reading_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND gid = #{gid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eh_reading_progress (user_id, gid, token, page, writer, seq, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gid}, #{token}, #{page}, #{writer}, #{seq}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, gid) DO UPDATE SET token = excluded.token, page = excluded.page, writer = excluded.writer, seq = excluded.seq, updated_at = now() WHERE eh_reading_progress.writer != excluded.writer OR eh_reading_progress.seq < excluded.seq
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM eh_reading_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND gid = #{gid}
